[[File:Crazy archaeologist chathead.png|left]]
'''Bellock''', the '''crazy archaeologist''', is a relatively simple [[boss]] that resides in the [[Ruins (west)|ruins]] south of [[The Forgotten Cemetery]] within level 23 [[Wilderness]]. His special attack mechanic is similar to that of the [[Deranged archaeologist]] and the [[Chaos Fanatic]].

The crazy archaeologist is notable for dropping one of the three shards that form the [[malediction ward]] and [[odium ward]], with the [[Chaos Fanatic]] and [[Scorpia]] dropping the other pieces. Killing all three at least  once is a hard [[Wilderness Diary]] task.

He is also a popular source for the [[rune crossbow]], particularly amongst low to mid-level [[Ironman Mode|ironmen]].

On a crazy archaeologist boss [[Slayer task]], the [[deranged archaeologist]] may be killed as an alternative, '''unless''' the [[Wilderness]] is specified as the task location when given by [[Krystilia]] or [[Konar quo Maten]].

The fastest way to get to the crazy archaeologist is by using the spell [[Dareeyak Teleport]] from the [[Ancient Magicks]] spellbook with 78 [[Magic]] or a [[Dareeyak teleport (tablet)|Dareeyak teleport tablet]]. Alternatives include:
*Rub a [[burning amulet]] to teleport to the [[Bandit Camp (Wilderness)|Bandit Camp]], just east of the ruins.
*Cast [[Trollheim Teleport]] (61 Magic), and then use the [[Rocks (Wilderness, Trollheim)|agility shortcut]] (64 Agility) that connects to the Wilderness.
*The [[Cemetery Teleport]] (71 Magic) on the [[Arceuus spellbook]] is also quite close.

==Fight overview==
{{main|Crazy archaeologist/Strategies}}
[[File:Fighting the Crazy archaeologist.png|thumb|left|250px|A player fights Bellock, the crazy archaeologist.]]
The crazy archaeologist is located in [[single-way combat]], meaning the player will be safe from player killers while in active combat with the boss.

He attacks primarily with [[Ranged]], only using [[Melee]] if the player is next to him. [[Protect from Ranged]] and [[Protect from Melee]] will nullify each respective attack.

Periodically, he will yell {{overhead|Rain of knowledge!}} before launching a special attack, throwing three books in an arc towards the player that explode in a 3x3 area. After exploding, one of the books will split into two more books on impact, with these also exploding nearby after a delay. '''This attack can deal large amounts of burst damage if not avoided!'''

Fighting from a distance will prevent him from using any melee attacks, allowing the use of [[Protect from Ranged]] to nullify all damage from his basic attacks, as well as giving the player more time to move away from his special attack.

[[Magic]] is particularly effective against the boss, as despite his high base [[Magic]] defence, he has a negligible Magic level; Magic defence is primarily based on one's Magic level.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/636095399070158848|date=25 August 2015|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/107525|archivedate=26 May 2020|quote=NPCs' magic defence is calculated off their Magic level, not their Defence level, and his is negligible.}}

==Trivia==
*The name "Bellock" is a reference to {{Wp|List of Indiana Jones characters#René Belloq|Belloq}} from ''{{Wp|Raiders of the Lost Ark|Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark}}''.
*The phrase, "You belong in a museum!" is a quote from ''[[wikipedia:Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade|Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade]]''.<!-- The quote from the movie says: "That belongs in a museum!" / "So do you!" -->
*The crazy archaeologist is the only Wilderness boss which does not drop a pet.
